executive_summary.conclusion: The sampled adult passport guidance is readable, publicly retrievable, and supports both tested visitor journeys. No verified discovery or task-completion barrier was found. The main localized uncertainty is a £16 paper-route reference on the linked processing-time page: the Check and Send guide establishes this as a separate service charge. Clarify that relationship first. Four intent tests were answered across relevant pages. Coverage is a bounded public sample, including four rendered documents; application submission, overseas flows, mobile/keyboard behavior, real crawler access, and actual assistant citations were not measured.

not_checked: The static collector sampled 11 HTML documents and one Atom feed; it selected several general GOV.UK navigation pages. Agent review added relevant renewal, application-entry, fee, entity, Check and Send, and external editorial documents. Page count is 17 distinct inspected HTML documents, canonicalizing the processing-time redirect.
Two sitemap children and the general news-page extraction were capped. No content-absence conclusion is drawn from them; the target and processing-time evidence were untruncated.
Mobile layout, keyboard reachability, visible focus, contrast, performance metrics, and accessibility conformance were not tested.
The browser used its default viewport and locale; exact dimensions and locale were not recorded. Cookie banners remained present but did not prevent the tested link actions or reading.

No forms were completed or submitted. The application service was observed only at its public location question; subsequent application, identity, payment, overseas, child and urgent-service flows were not exercised.
No actual assistant-answer runs, provider crawler logs/IP access, Search Console settings, owner analytics, conversion, retention, or citation probability were measured.

proactive_opportunities.title: Clarify the separate Check and Send charge in processing-time guidance
proactive_opportunities.rationale: At https://www.gov.uk/government/organisations/hm-passport-office/about/about-our-services#how-to-apply, the paper-form route says an extra £16 without naming Check and Send. The renewal and fee pages distinguish the £102 online and £115.50 standard paper application fees, while https://www.gov.uk/how-the-post-office-check-and-send-service-works explicitly identifies £16 as the Check and Send charge. The supporting guide resolves the issue, so this is a localized clarification opportunity rather than a verified fee contradiction or blocked journey.
proactive_opportunities.owner_hint: HM Passport Office content owner for About our services
proactive_opportunities.mechanism: Name Check and Send and link its guide next to the £16 reference; distinguish the optional service charge from the paper passport application fee. This lets readers and retrieved passages preserve the correct fee context.
proactive_opportunities.verification: Review the How to apply paragraph in HTML and the rendered page. It should identify which service costs £16, state that the charge is additional to the relevant application fee, and link to the current Check and Send and passport fee guidance.

readiness.detail: The collector received HTTP 200 for 11 of 11 sampled HTML documents. For the supplied path, robots.txt permits Googlebot, bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot and PerplexityBot under the applicable wildcard group. Training/control and user-fetch decisions are separately preserved in evidence.json. The target has a self-canonical and no recorded robots/googlebot/bingbot meta restriction or X-Robots-Tag. The /print and /search/all policies were not treated as defects. Published policy and local GET success do not prove real provider access.

The target and processing-time page retain decision facts in untruncated source HTML and rendered accessibility text. The landing page's three JSON-LD blocks parse without errors and include the same current adult fees in Article/FAQ content. Readable facts include eligibility, fees, tracking and timing links. Old Article dateModified metadata alone was not treated as evidence that current guidance is stale; no missing-schema or word-count finding was created.

Four realistic UK adult-renewal question tests, with expected elements recorded before supporting-route review, were answered across the landing page, renewal guide, timing guidance and fee table. The fee context clarification is O-001; the supporting Check and Send guide prevents a false contradiction claim.

On 2026-09-08, web.run queries were exactly: HM Passport Office; renew British adult passport online cost; UK passport renewal £102 £115.50 2026; UK passport renewal processing time 3 weeks September 2026. The pooled results returned first-party HM Passport Office identity and current fee guidance, plus MoneyWeek's renewal article updated 24 July 2026. Opened fee and editorial pages agree on standard UK adult fees (£102 online, £115.50 paper). MoneyWeek attributes guidance to GOV.UK, so this is independent publication carrying consistent claims, not independent operational measurement. No same-entity contradiction was established. Exact query and source records are in ledger.md.

Two safe journeys reached their expected public destinations in a dedicated browser tab. Renew led to preparation guidance and the labeled Apply for a passport location question; the processing-time link reached guidance stating the usual period, timing start and exceptions. A cookie banner did not prevent either journey. Primary labels and application radio names were exposed in the accessibility tree. No site-selected personal context existed to test retention.

intent_tests.question: Who can use the adult passport renewal service?

evidence.quote: aged 16 or over (or turning 16 in the next 3 weeks)

intent_tests.reason: The landing page specifies the adult threshold and links distinct child, first-adult-passport and overseas routes. The renewal guide requires the existing passport and distinguishes expired/insufficient validity, lost/damaged passports, and name changes. UK adult renewal is the inferred primary task.

intent_tests.question: What does an adult renewal cost online or on paper?
intent_tests.reason: The fee table explicitly identifies standard adult UK online and paper prices in pounds; landing and renewal pages agree. Different overseas, frequent-traveller, urgent and Check and Send contexts are identified in linked guidance. O-001 addresses naming the additional service charge on one supporting page.

intent_tests.question: How long should a UK applicant allow, and where is urgent guidance?

evidence.quote: You’ll usually get your passport within 3 weeks.
The processing time starts from when we receive your documents.

intent_tests.reason: The linked timing page explains that additional information or an interview may take longer, distinguishes overseas times, and links Online Premium/1 week Fast Track and compassionate urgent-travel advice. This is public guidance as observed, not an individual processing guarantee.

intent_tests.question: What is needed to renew and how do I begin?

evidence.quote: Do you live in the UK?

intent_tests.reason: Renewal instructions list passport and photo/payment preparation, including handling valid foreign passports. The Renew online action successfully reached the official public application filter. The audit stopped before answering or submitting the form.
